Document.en: The root of a JDX document: the declaration and its lists of parties, works, recordings, agreements and media.

Document.$schema.en: URI of the schema of the document's minor version, for example `https://jdx.jupiter.ar/schema/1.0/jdx.schema.json`. Validators do not download it: they use their bundled schemas.

Document.profiles.en: Profiles that the issuer believes apply. Informative: the receiver chooses the profile.

Document.declaration.en: Which declaration, which revision, and who issues it.

Document.parties.en: Persons and organisations: writers, publishers, performers, producers, representatives. Each appears once and is referenced by its id.

Document.agreements.en: Signed agreements: publishing, sub-publishing, split letters between co-writers, authorisations.

Document.media.en: Files delivered separately (PDF, audio, spreadsheets), described by size and hash.

Document.edition.en: The published edition. When absent, the declaration is of unpublished works.

Declaration.en: The declaration data: stable identifier, revision and issuer.

Declaration.id.en: Stable identifier of the declaration; the same in all its revisions.

Declaration.revision.en: Revision number. It increases with every resubmission; the receiver replaces the whole declaration when a revision greater than the last one loaded arrives.

Declaration.createdAt.en: When this revision was assembled. Equal, as an instant, to `issuedAt` in the signature header.

Declaration.issuer.en: The issuer that assembles and signs the document.

Declaration.declarant.en: Who declares: the publisher or, for unpublished works, the writer.

Declaration.recipients.en: Societies to which the declaration is addressed.

Declaration.language.en: Language of the free-text fields of the document.

Issuer.en: The issuer of the document, as listed in the trust list.

Issuer.id.en: Issuer identifier in the trust list.

Issuer.keyId.en: Thumbprint (`kid`) of the key that signs the document.

Recipient.society.en: Society code: a CISAC code (3 digits, e.g. `061`) or a JDX code (`X_JDX_` prefix).

Name.en: A name of a person or organisation.

Name.type.en: Name type: legal name, pseudonym or trade name.

Name.given.en: Given name or names. Persons only.

Name.family.en: Family name or names. Persons only.

Name.full.en: Full name without breakdown: pseudonyms, trade names and organisations.

Identifier.en: An identifier with its scheme: IPI, ISNI, ISWC, ISRC, tax or national identifiers, a society's own code, and others.

Identifier.scheme.en: Identifier scheme. Schemes specific to an issuer or society carry the `X_` prefix.

Identifier.value.en: The value, as text. Its format is checked by profile rules (`JDX-IDN-*`), not by the schema.

Identifier.country.en: Country that issues the tax identifier or identity document.

Identifier.type.en: Type of tax identifier or identity document (`CUIT`, `DNI`, `CPF`, …).

Identifier.issuer.en: Label that assigned the catalogue number.

Classification.en: The genre of a work, according to the vocabulary of whoever defines it.

Classification.code.en: Genre code in that vocabulary. Free text in the schema; checked against the bundled list by `JDX-CLS-001`.

Classification.name.en: Genre name. For `SADAIC_GENRE` it identifies the genre together with `code`, because the list repeats codes.

Condition.en: A condition of an agreement that changes the publisher cap.

Condition.code.en: Condition code in that vocabulary; checked by `JDX-CLS-001`.

StandardContract.en: The standard contract on which an agreement is based.

StandardContract.code.en: Standard-contract code in that vocabulary; checked by `JDX-CLS-001`.

Territories.en: Territories as CISAC TIS codes: the included territories minus the excluded ones.

Territories.exclude.en: Territories subtracted from the included ones.

Address.en: A postal address. The whole object is personal data when it belongs to a party.

Place.en: A place: city, subdivision and country.

Contact.phone.en: Telephone number in international E.164 form, for example `+5491155550000`.

Amount.en: A monetary amount with its currency.

Amount.amount.en: Amount as decimal text with up to 4 decimals, for example `"1500.00"`.

Registration.en: A registration with a national authority: deposit of a work, registration of an agreement or of a pseudonym.

Registration.kind.en: What was registered: unpublished work, published work, agreement or pseudonym.

Registration.expiryDate.en: Expiry date of the registration, if any.

Registration.filing.en: The file of the filing submitted to the authority.

Registration.certificate.en: The file of the official certificate. It may arrive in a later revision.

WorkRegistration.en: A registration of a work, which also states the part of the work registered. Used only in works; in any other registration, `part` is an unknown member.

WorkRegistration.kind.en: What was registered: unpublished work, published work, agreement or pseudonym.

WorkRegistration.part.en: Registered part: music, lyrics or both.

WorkRegistration.expiryDate.en: Expiry date of the registration, if any.

WorkRegistration.filing.en: The file of the filing submitted to the authority.

WorkRegistration.certificate.en: The file of the official certificate. It may arrive in a later revision.

Party.en: A person or organisation: writer, publisher, performer, producer, representative, successor.

Party.id.en: Local id, unique in the document (`p1`).

Party.names.en: Names: the legal name and any pseudonyms or trade names.

Party.identifiers.en: Identifiers: IPI, ISNI, tax and national identifiers, and others.

Party.deathDate.en: Date of death. Relevant to public domain and successors.

Party.affiliations.en: Societies with which the party is affiliated, with its member number.

Party.legalRepresentatives.en: Parent or guardian of a writer who is a minor.

Party.representatives.en: Persons who represent an organisation and may sign on its behalf.

Party.media.en: Files of the party, for example a tax registration certificate.

Affiliation.en: The affiliation of a party with a society.

Affiliation.memberNumber.en: Member number or, for a publisher, its account number with the society.

Affiliation.rights.en: Rights that the society administers for the party. When absent, all rights.

Affiliation.territories.en: Territories of the affiliation. When absent, the World (`2136`).

Affiliation.endDate.en: End date. When absent, the affiliation is current.

LegalRepresentative.en: The legal representative of a writer who is a minor.

Successor.en: An heir or successor in title.

Successor.capacity.en: Capacity: `heir` (`heir`) or unified representative of the heirs (`unifiedRepresentative`).

Representative.en: A person who represents an organisation.

Representative.party.en: The person who represents the organisation.

Representative.role.en: Position: managing partner, director, president, attorney or partner.

Representative.title.en: The position as printed, for example "Managing partner".

Representative.signatory.en: Whether the person may sign on behalf of the organisation.

Work.id.en: Local id, unique in the document (`w1`).

Work.titles.en: Titles: the original title and any others. At least one; this is the declared exception to the optional business fields (5.6).

Work.identifiers.en: ISWC, the work code in a society, the issuer's id.

Work.distributionCategory.en: CISAC distribution category: popular, serious, jazz or unclassified.

Work.textMusicRelationship.en: Music only, text only, music and text, or music and text combined but not written for each other (CWR MUS, TXT, MTX, MTN).

Work.registrations.en: National registrations of the work (for example, a deposit with the copyright office), by part.

Work.version.en: Whether the work is original or derived (arrangement, adaptation, translation), and from which work.

Work.composite.en: Whether the work combines other works: medley, potpourri, mashup.

Work.excerptOf.en: Work of which this work is an excerpt.

Work.commissioned.en: Whether the work was commissioned, and by whom.

Work.ai.en: Involvement of artificial intelligence in the work.

Work.instrumentation.en: Voices and instruments, for concert music.

Work.grandRights.en: Whether the work is a dramatico-musical work.

Work.origin.en: Audiovisual or advertising use for which the work was created.

Work.contributors.en: Who created the work and in which roles.

Work.authorship.en: Original ownership, by part (music and lyrics), as percentages of the whole work. The rows of a work sum to at most 100.

Work.shares.en: Who collects: rows by right and territory, each with the percentage of the whole work that it collects.

Work.recordings.en: Recordings of the work. Must match `works` of each recording (`JDX-REF-004`).

Work.media.en: Files of the work: score, lyrics, declaration form.

Title.type.en: Title type: original, alternative, translated, transliterated, first line, and others.

FirstPerformance.en: The first public performance of a work.

WorkRef.en: A reference to another `work`: a `work` of the document (`work`) or an `external` `work` (`external`).

WorkRef.external.en: A work that is not in the document.

External.en: A work that is not in the document.

External.publicDomain.en: Whether the work is in the public domain, as declared by the issuer. The validator does not compute it.

ExternalWriter.en: A writer of an external work.

ExternalWriter.deathDate.en: Date of death. Relevant to public domain.

Version.en: Whether the work is original or derived from another work.

Version.type.en: Original, arrangement, adaptation, translation, lyric replacement or other.

Version.original.en: The source work of a derived work.

Version.authorization.en: The agreement that authorises the derivation. Not needed when the source work is in the public domain (`JDX-WRK-001`).

Composite.en: A work made of other works.

Composite.type.en: Medley, potpourri, composite work, mashup or work with samples.

Composite.components.en: The works that make up the composite work.

Component.en: A `work` that is part of a composite `work`: a `work` of the document (`work`) or an `external` `work` (`external`), with its duration.

Component.external.en: A work that is not in the document.

Ai.en: The involvement of artificial intelligence in a work, by element.

Ai.declared.en: Whether the declarant reported on artificial intelligence. Absent or `false` means "not reported", not "no AI".

Ai.elements.en: Involvement in each element: lyrics, melody, harmony, arrangement.

Ai.humanContribution.en: Description of the human creative contribution.

AiElement.en: The involvement of artificial intelligence in one element of the work.

AiElement.element.en: Element: lyrics, melody, harmony or arrangement.

Instrumentation.en: The voices and instruments of a work.

Instrument.en: An instrument of a work, with its count.

Instrument.scheme.en: Instrument vocabulary. No vocabulary is recommended yet: issuers use their own `X_` schemes.

Instrument.count.en: Number of instruments of this kind.

Origin.en: The audiovisual or advertising use for which a work was created (CWR ORN record).

Origin.purpose.en: Intended purpose: film, television, advertising, library music, radio, theatre, video game (CWR ORN intended purpose).

Origin.usage.en: How the music is used: background, logo, theme, visual or rolled-up cue (CWR BLTVR).

Origin.identifiers.en: Identifiers of the production, for example the ISAN.

Contributor.en: Who created the work and in which role.

Contributor.roles.en: Roles: composer, lyricist, arranger, adapter, translator, and others. At least one.

Contributor.creditedAs.en: Name under which the contributor is credited in the publication.

Authorship.en: The share of the whole work that a writer holds for the music or for the lyrics.

Authorship.percent.en: Percentage of the whole work. If Ana wrote all the music and Beto all the lyrics, each holds 50; a writer of both parts holds 50 for the music and 50 for the lyrics. The rows of a work sum to at most 100.

Authorship.agreement.en: The split agreement between co-writers, if any.

Share.en: A share row: who collects which percentage of the whole work, by right and territory.

Share.role.en: Role: writer, original publisher, sub-publisher, substituted publisher, administrator, income participant or acquirer.

Share.via.en: Where the share comes from: for an original publisher, the writer it represents (one row per writer; several in one row only if the agreement gives them the same percentage); for a sub-publisher, the original publisher.

Share.agreement.en: The agreement that grants the share.

Share.rights.en: Rights: performing, mechanical, synchronisation, print. When absent, those of the agreement; when the agreement does not state them, all four.

Share.territories.en: Territories. When absent, those of the agreement; when the agreement does not state them, the World (`2136`).

Share.percent.en: Percentage of the whole work, already computed. For a publisher, the `publisherShare.percent` of its agreement times the authorship of the writers in `via`, divided by 100: 25 % of a writer who holds 50 is 12.5.

Recording.en: A recording of one or more works.

Recording.id.en: Local id, unique in the document (`r1`).

Recording.displayArtist.en: Artist as shown in the credits.

Recording.identifiers.en: ISRC, the recording code in a society, the issuer's id.

Recording.works.en: Works that the recording contains. Must match `recordings` of each work (`JDX-REF-004`).

Recording.purposes.en: Why it is delivered: registration audio, commercial or reference.

Recording.type.en: Type: studio, live, remix, library or demo.

Recording.fixationCountry.en: Country where the recording was made.

Recording.release.en: Release in which the recording was published.

Recording.contributors.en: Other contributors: studio producer, engineers, remixer.

Recording.ai.en: Involvement of artificial intelligence in the recording.

Recording.languageOfPerformance.en: Language in which it is sung.

Recording.media.en: Files of the recording: the audio.

IsrcIssuer.en: Who assigned the ISRC of a recording.

FirstPublication.en: The first publication of a recording.

Producer.percent.en: Percentage of ownership of the master.

PLine.text.en: Full text, for example "`℗ 2026 Sello Sur`".

Release.en: A release (album, single) in which the recording was published.

Performer.role.en: Role: main, featured, conductor, session musician, background vocalist or ensemble.

Performer.societyCategories.en: The performer's category in a performers' society, when known.

Performer.members.en: Members, if the performer is an ensemble.

PerformerInstrument.en: An instrument played by a performer.

PerformerInstrument.scheme.en: Instrument vocabulary. No vocabulary is recommended yet: issuers use their own `X_` schemes.

SocietyCategory.en: The category of a performer in a society.

SocietyCategory.code.en: Category in that society, for example `G1`.

RecordingContributor.en: A technical or artistic contributor to a recording.

RecordingContributor.role.en: Role: studio producer, recording, mixing or mastering engineer, remixer.

Sample.en: A sampled `recording`: a `recording` of the document (`recording`) or an `external` `recording` (`external`).

Sample.external.en: A recording that is not in the document.

Sample.authorization.en: The agreement that authorises the use.

ExternalRecording.en: A recording that is not in the document.

ExternalRecording.displayArtist.en: Artist as shown in the credits.

RecordingAi.en: The involvement of artificial intelligence in a recording, by element.

RecordingAi.declared.en: Whether the declarant reported on artificial intelligence. Absent or `false` means "not reported", not "no AI".

RecordingAi.elements.en: Involvement in each element: vocals, instruments, arrangement.

RecordingAiElement.en: The involvement of artificial intelligence in one element of the recording.

Link.en: A publication on a digital platform.

Link.platform.en: Platform: Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, and others.

Agreement.id.en: Local id, unique in the document (`a1`).

Agreement.uid.en: Stable identifier of the agreement: recognises it across revisions and from other declarations.

Agreement.type.en: Type: publishing (co-publishing when there are several grantees), sub-publishing, administration, assignment, authorisation of a derived work, or split agreement between co-writers.

Agreement.identifiers.en: Agreement number of the issuer or of a society.

Agreement.parent.en: Agreement on which this one depends; for example, a sub-publishing agreement points to its publishing agreement.

Agreement.works.en: Works of this declaration that the agreement covers.

Agreement.numberOfWorks.en: Total number of works of the agreement.

Agreement.scope.en: Whether it covers specific works or a catalogue.

Agreement.grantedRights.en: What the agreement transfers; under the standard contract, the printed edition (`print`).

Agreement.rights.en: Rights in which the publisher participates.

Agreement.term.en: Term: the copyright protection period or a fixed term.

Agreement.endDate.en: End of the term. With a fixed term, the start date plus the duration (`JDX-AGR-005`).

Agreement.postTermCollection.en: Collection after the end of the agreement.

Agreement.publisherShare.en: What the agreement gives the publisher over the share of those who grant it, with the condition that raises the cap, if any.

Agreement.terms.en: Template, standard contract and agreed values.

Agreement.registrations.en: Registration of the agreement with an authority (`kind` `contract`).

AgreementParty.role.en: Role: `grantor` (`grantor`), `grantee` (`grantee`) or co-writer (`coWriter`, in a split agreement).

AgreementParent.en: The `agreement` on which another `agreement` depends: an `agreement` of the document (`agreement`) or of another declaration (`uid`).

AgreementParent.uid.en: The `uid` of an agreement of another declaration.

ExcludedRight.en: A right excluded from an agreement.

ExcludedRight.observation.en: Text of the observation that excludes it.

Term.basis.en: The copyright protection period (`protectionPeriod`) or a `fixed` term (`fixed`).

Term.duration.en: Duration of the fixed term, for example `P10Y`.

PostTermCollection.en: Collection after the end of an agreement.

PostTermCollection.status.en: No post-term collection (`none`), without end `date` (`openEnded`) or until a `date` (`date`).

PublisherShare.en: The percentage that an agreement gives the publisher over the share of those who grant it.

PublisherShare.percent.en: Percentage of the agreement over the share of each `grantor` in the work, not over the whole work: with 25 and a writer who holds 50, the publisher collects 12.5 of the work. Publisher caps are compared with this value.

PublisherShare.condition.en: Condition that allows the cap to be exceeded, for example one of article 8 of the standard contract (`SADAIC_ART8`).

Terms.template.en: Issuer template from which the agreement was generated.

Terms.basedOn.en: Standard contract on which the agreement is based.

Template.en: The issuer template from which an agreement was generated.

TermValues.en: Values agreed under a standard contract.

TermValues.retailPricePercent.en: Percentage of the retail price of the printed edition.

TermValues.arrangementRetailPricePercent.en: Percentage of the retail price of orchestrations and transcriptions.

TermValues.collectionStart.en: When collection starts: the semester of the filing or the next one.

InvestedAmount.en: The amount invested by the publisher.

InvestedAmount.status.en: Whether the amount is `determined` (`determined`) or not (`undetermined`).

Observation.en: An observation printed in an agreement.

Observation.article.en: Article that the observation modifies, as text (`"10"`).

Edition.identifiers.en: Edition number of the issuer or of a society.

Edition.type.en: Type: single, album or complete works (`integral`).

Edition.ordinal.en: Edition number (1 for the first edition).

Edition.works.en: Works of the edition, in order.

Edition.registrations.en: Registration of the edition as a published work.

Edition.media.en: Files of the edition: copy, print-run statement, society form, registration filing.

PrintRun.en: The print run of an edition.

Deposit.en: The legal deposit of an edition.

Deposit.copy.en: The file of the `copy`. When `sha256` and `copy` are both present, the hashes must match (`JDX-MED-009`).

Media.en: A file delivered separately, described by its size and hash.

Media.id.en: Local id, unique in the document (`m1`).

Media.kind.en: What the file is: signed agreement, split agreement, legal-deposit copy, print-run statement, registration filing or certificate, society form, declaration form, score, lyrics, audio, and others.

Media.mediaType.en: Media type of the file, for example `application/pdf`.

Media.size.en: Size in bytes of the delivered file.

Media.sha256.en: SHA-256 hash of the exact bytes of the delivered file.

Media.path.en: Path relative to the delivery root: segments of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]` separated by `/`. Its text is checked by `JDX-MED-001`.

Media.delivery.en: Revision in which the file was delivered. A file already delivered is declared again in later revisions, with its delivery revision.

Media.delivered.en: `false` when the file is declared but not delivered. Default: `true`.

Media.personalData.en: Whether the file contains personal data.

Media.evidence.en: Evidence of the signature of the document.

Evidence.en: Evidence of the signature of a document.

Evidence.esignature.en: Electronic signature: provider, legal class and time-stamp.

Evidence.annexed.en: Files annexed to the document, with the hash printed in the annex.

Evidence.anchors.en: Anchorings of the document in a blockchain.

ESignature.en: The electronic signature of a document.

ESignature.envelopeId.en: Identifier of the document at the provider.

ESignature.legalClass.en: Electronic signature or digital signature, in the sense of the applicable law.

ESignature.identityMethods.en: How the signers were identified: invitation link, code by email or SMS, TOTP, digital certificate.

ESignature.contactSource.en: Who entered the signers' contact data: the declarant or the signer.

Timestamp.en: The RFC 3161 time-stamp of a document.

Timestamp.source.en: Where it was taken from: the time-stamp embedded in the PDF (`pdfEmbedded`) or the time-stamping authority response reported by the provider (`tsa`).

Timestamp.generatedAt.en: Date and time of the time-stamp (`genTime`).

Signer.onBehalfOf.en: On whose behalf the party signed, when representing an organisation.

Annexed.en: A file annexed to a document.

Annexed.fileName.en: File name as shown in the annex.

Annexed.media.en: The file, if it is delivered. Its hash must match (`JDX-MED-009`).

Anchor.en: An anchoring of a document in a blockchain.
